# Tobías Lifschitz

> Embedded systems engineer building low-power wireless sensor platforms from concept to large-scale field deployment, based in Buenos Aires, Argentina. Personal site covering professional background, technical work, and occasional engineering writeups.

Tobías works across the full stack of a hardware product — hardware design, firmware, application software, and some backend. He is the Embedded Systems Technical Lead at Maper (a B2B industrial IoT startup), where he helped scale a wireless vibration monitoring platform from prototype to over 10,000 deployed devices. He is also a contributor to the open-source C++ BLE stack SimpleBLE, and has reverse-engineered Bluetooth protocols of commercial glucose meters.

## About
- [Home](https://tlifschitz.com/): Landing page — who Tobías is (Engineer · Maker · Explorer) and a photo carousel.
- [About Me](https://tlifschitz.com/aboutme/): Professional background, technical stack (hardware, firmware, application, backend), and current work.

## Writing
- [Mitigating battery drainage during reset loops](https://tlifschitz.com/2024-07-27-limiting-reset-rate/): Firmware technique to extend battery life on an EFR32 device suffering undesired reset loops caused by voltage drops.
